mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agenda_ovie.solicitudes( id_horario, nombre, telefono, celular, correo,consulta, fecha_solicitud, fecha_cita, status,sexo,edad,ocupacion,domicilio) VALUES (#{schedule}, #{name},#{tel},#{phone},#{mail},#{question}, now(),#{request}, 1,#{sex},#{age},#{occupation},#{address});
mapper.select: SELECT id_horario as schedule, hora_in, hora_fn, dia FROM agenda_ovie.horario order by hora_in ;
